name: BetterScrollFlight
author: LensError
description:
While in fly/noclip mode (only in worlds that allow flight), scrolling the mouse wheel adjusts your flight speed multiplier. Middle-click resets speed to 1x. An optional modifier key (default: Left Ctrl) can be required so that normal scrolling is unaffected.

Settings via the Mods settings panel (UI Expansion Kit required):
- Enable/disable the mod
- Show/hide the HUD speed readout while flying
- Toggle whether a modifier key must be held
- Cycle through modifier keys (Left Shift, Left Ctrl, Left Alt, Caps Lock)
- Adjust scroll sensitivity (5–50% change per tick, shown as slider)
- Live speed scale readout and reset button

Speed scale persists between sessions. Only affects flight speed when the world has flight enabled.
